$comment: THE list of files no formatter may rewrite, and the single source both
Each of these files has a program that owns its bytes: a serializer, a
generator, a minifier, or a byte-comparing gate. When a formatter also
rewrites them, the two writers undo each other forever — every commit
carries thousands of lines of churn, and byte-comparing checks
for reasons unrelated to the change under review.
This kept happening because the knowledge lived in two hand-maintained
places (.prettierignore and lint-staged.config.mjs) with nothing tying
them together: .wolf/buglog.json and .wolf/anatomy.md were in neither,
and prettier rewrote 1,643 lines of the bug log the first time it was
TO ADD A FILE: add an entry here. `pattern` must then appear verbatim as
otherwise), and lint-staged.config.mjs reads this file directly, so no
second list can drift. `samples` are real paths used by
scripts/verify-formatter-ignores.mjs to ask prettier and lint-staged
whether they would actually touch them.

entries.why: The wolf-memory MCP server writes one entry per line group in its own layout and allocates ids atomically. Prettier collapses its arrays; the next bug_log call rewrites the file back.
Regenerated wholesale by the anatomy scanner in its own layout; reformatting it guarantees a diff against the next regeneration.
The product SOT. Byte-compared by scripts/sync_product_registry.py --check and sha256-pinned in assets/products/manifest.json. The root path is a symlink, so a write through it lands on the registry.
The real file behind the root symlink — the one editable product SOT.
Generated projections of the registry, byte-compared by sync_product_registry.py --check. They also carry the founder's verbatim specifications, which no formatter may reflow.
Deterministic generator output behind a byte-for-byte freshness gate.
Generated report; reformatting breaks the same freshness gate.
Generated shoot list; same gate.
Canonical dossier generation owns these bytes; generic Markdown formatting desynchronizes the checked-in placement brief.

Quarantined artifacts kept exactly as produced.

entries.owner: vendored Draco decoder (upstream build artefact, three copies)
entries.why: Emscripten output, served to production. Prettier expands it 719,410 -> 2,929,568 bytes (measured 2026-09-20), so every visitor downloads a 4x larger decoder and the vendored copy no longer matches upstream.
Generated and byte-compared by verify-collection-sot. Prettier rewrites it 15,325 -> 15,142 bytes, so the gate reports STALE, --fix regenerates, and the formatter undoes it again on the retry.
Generated and byte-compared by validate_catalog_consistency. Prettier rewrites it 17,118 -> 25,176 bytes, which makes that byte check unsatisfiable.
Written tab-indented by its generator; prettier re-indents it (1,677 -> 1,752 bytes) and the next build writes it straight back.
Generated collection hub markup that is deployed as-is. Prettier rewrites it 8,759 -> 10,842 bytes, changing what ships.

entries.owner: every session (append-only one-row-per-action log, founder-mandated in every commit)
entries.why: Rows are single long table lines read per line. proseWrap reflows them, and because a row is appended in EVERY commit this is the highest-frequency exposure of the whole list.

entries.owner: OpenWolf cross-session learning log (appended by every session)
entries.why: Prettier rewrites it 156,585 -> 160,446 bytes, renumbering and re-indenting entries that sessions append to by position.
Prettier rewrites it 12,998 -> 21,331 bytes, moving the AUTO region markers its generator edits between.
